text_block_list.name: Heart & Messiah
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Really! You're truly 
unbelievable, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Cesario's been rising rapidly since the 
start of the year, and I have to keep an 
eye on her on top of everything else.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Rhein Kraft. You really are... a 
handful...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That tenacity, that front-running 
prowess... The power and speed honed to 
absolute perfection in order to dominate 
races in the mile division...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume to look out for in the Oka 
Sho is, naturally...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hah... H-Ha...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Oooooooooh!! Rhein Kraft, that was an 
incredible run!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible speed!! Awesome run, 
Craaaftーー!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (A good run... Yes, that was a good run.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't feel like I'd lose at all! Even 
with Heart-san and Messiah-san as my 
opponents!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(My legs were filled with power the whole 
time. With every step, I could accelerate 
just like I pictured... I even felt like I 
could go even faster!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(More... even more!! I got so thrilled 
knowing I could get even faster—!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Unlike those training sessions... that 
were painfully, agonizingly unbearable.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: “Still... but! Still, I...!”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (What... do I want to do—?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is... the Oka Sho. 
Right on the path I've always dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: However, what lies beyond that—?
